posts.text: 💡 Rule #1 in Cookie Clicker Always buy the most expensive building you can afford right now. It almost always bakes more cookies per second than a handful of cheap ones. Check it — open the buildings tab 👇

😄 “I'll just hop in for a minute”

…leaves 40 minutes later after buying three new buildings and an upgrade.

Sound familiar? Then you're one of us. 🍪

👑 Upgrades multiply — they don't just add One upgrade can give ×2 to a building's whole output. That's not “+5 cookies” — that's multiplied growth. Don't save up for them — grab them the moment they unlock 👇
🏆 Show your cps! How many cookies per second are you at right now? Screenshot and flex — let's see who's the real cookie empire. Check your rank here 👇
⚡ Cookie Hour is near Twice a day, ×2 production kicks in. Catch the window and cookies pile up twice as fast. We ping you when it starts. Don't miss it 👇

⭐ When should you ascend? When growth slows and new buildings take forever to afford. Ascending resets your progress but grants a permanent +% to production — and the next run is much faster. Check your bonus 👇
🤝 One friend = a permanent boost Every active friend gives you a permanent production boost. Not one-time — forever, as long as they play. Invite your first 👇
🎁 Don't skip your daily reward Log in every day and your streak grows — and so does the bonus. Miss a day and the streak resets. Simple math in your favor. Claim today's 👇
😴 Cookies pile up even offline Close the game and your army keeps baking. Come back to offline income for the whole time you were away. The more buildings, the fatter the return 👇
🏆 Top players of the week The best bakers are already climbing by ascension count. Want to see your name up here? Open the Top tab and aim for the lead 👇
🌟 Reaching the Golden Age faster 1️⃣ Invest in buildings, don't camp on clicks 2️⃣ Buy upgrades right away 3️⃣ Ascend a couple times for the permanent bonus 4️⃣ Collect your daily reward Let's go 👇

😅 “Just one more building, then bed”

*buys five more buildings, two upgrades, and decides to ascend*

Cookie Clicker: 1, sleep: 0. 🍪
💡 Clicking is the start, not the strategy Your finger only gets you so far. Real growth is buildings baking for you 24/7. Grab your first couple of buildings and feel the difference 👇
🫶 An exclusive building for friends Gather 10 active friends and unlock a special “gift of friends” building. Placed for free, it bakes alongside your whole army. Start building your crew 👇
👑 Prestige tiers: how far can you go Ascensions unlock new content tiers — all the way to tier 10. Each tier means new buildings, upgrades, and status. The ceiling is high. See where you are 👇
🔧 What's cooking We keep shipping content: new tiers, events and mechanics. Got ideas or bugs? Send them to the bot with /feedback — we read everything. Meanwhile, keep baking 👇

🥇 Friend titles — collect all three 25 friends — “Social Cookie” 50 — “Cookie Legend” 100 — “Cookie Emperor” Everyone sees your title in your profile and the leaderboard. There's only one Emperor among us 😏 Invite friends 👇
❓ Common question: will I lose my progress? Nope — progress is saved, there's cross-device sync, and you can switch language (EN/RU) in Settings. Play with peace of mind 👇
💥 Combo of the day Buy out a tier's upgrades → ascend for the permanent boost → dive into the next tier stronger than before. That's how a real empire grows. Your move 👇
🌙 Evening check-in Claim your offline income, buy a couple buildings, leave it running overnight — wake up to another fat return. 30 seconds now = a boost by morning 👇
